newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends pre-Christmas trade mixed.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends pre-Christmas trade mixed.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - The market closed mixed on pre-holiday covering in late trading. Trading was slow with players unwilling to trade ahead of the Christmas holiday. Lack of leads also dampened the market which is waiting for Dec 1-25 palm oil export by SGS (M) Sdn Bhd on Thursday.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - The market saw scattered interest. Reopens on Thursday 26.
Cargo surveyor SGS (M) Sdn Bhd is expected to release the December 1-25 palm oil export on Thursday.
Traders said prices are likely to hold steady at around current lewvels due to the underlying firm fundamentals.
Trades had expected output in December to fall by 15 to 17 percent from November.
Futures prices were traded within a seven-ringgit range, with third month, March futures closing four ringgit up at 1,229 ringgit ($486.35) a tonne.
Among physical, Dec (south) saw offers at 1,255 ringgit against bids at 1,250 after trading at 1,250.
Dec (central) was offered at 1,250 and bids at 1,245 with earlier trades of 1,245.
Jan (south) saw offers at 1,255 and bids at 1,250 with earlier trades at 1,250 and Jan (central) at 1,250 and bids at 1,245.
Feb (south) was offered at 1,255 and bids at 1,250.
Among refined products, Jan/Feb/Mch RBD palm oil was offered at $527.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Feb/March at $527.50.
Jan RBD palm olein saw offers at $565, Feb/Mar at $560, and Apr/May/June at $552.50.

Jan RBD palm stearin was offered at $402.50, Feb/Mar at $405, and Jan/Feb palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $292.50. Turnover on the futures market was 469 lots against 914 on Monday. The market reopens on December 26.
